name: std-status-lifecycle
description: Infra substrate: data-driven entity status lifecycle. The statuses and the allowed transitions are config data over a fixed single-state topology, so a host organism can expand or collapse its lifecycle without forking. Compose onto an entity, rename the ChangeStatusRequested listen to the host's status-change action, and supply `states` + `transitions`. A requested move is validated against the `transitions` table (illegal moves are rejected), then the new value is written to `statusField` on the target entity and StatusChanged is emitted. Surfaces nothing — the host renders the badge and buttons.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current lifecycle status of the record.

emits.description: Internal: the status write landed; carries the persisted row flat.

states.label: What are the possible statuses?
states.description: The complete set of statuses a record can hold.
states.synonyms: states, stages, phases, statuses, lifecycle, workflow steps

transitions.label: Which status moves are allowed?
transitions.description: Legal transitions as { from, to, event, label }. Only matching moves are applied.
transitions.synonyms: edges, allowed moves, status flow, workflow transitions

statusField.label: Which field holds the status?
statusField.synonyms: state field, stage field, status column, lifecycle field

initialStatus.label: What status do new records start in?
initialStatus.description: The status assigned when a record is first created.
initialStatus.synonyms: starting state, default status, first stage, initial state

targetEntity.label: Target entity
targetEntity.description: Entity name whose status field this lifecycle drives (e.g. 'Contract'). Rebind per composition. Typed `entity`, so a rename of the bound entity threads through to this value automatically.

enabled.label: Enforce status lifecycle rules?
enabled.description: Validate and apply status transitions against the configured table. Off by default.
enabled.synonyms: lifecycle, statuses, states, stages, workflow, status transitions, enforce, enable, apply
